# Generated by westminster/tools/ui/build_polls_panel.py - edit there.
wm_ui_polls_toggle = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = wm_ui_polls_open }
			remove_variable = wm_ui_polls_open
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = wm_ui_polls_open value = yes }
			wm_ui_count_seats_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
# The tabs: what is shown is read in the GUI as the player's variables wm_ui_tab_chamber / wm_ui_tab_tracker
wm_ui_polls_tab_poll = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		remove_variable = wm_ui_tab_chamber
		remove_variable = wm_ui_tab_tracker
		
	}
}
wm_ui_polls_tab_chamber = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		remove_variable = wm_ui_tab_chamber
		remove_variable = wm_ui_tab_tracker
		set_variable = { name = wm_ui_tab_chamber value = yes }
	}
}
wm_ui_polls_tab_tracker = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		remove_variable = wm_ui_tab_chamber
		remove_variable = wm_ui_tab_tracker
		set_variable = { name = wm_ui_tab_tracker value = yes }
	}
}
